theater: 克里米亞半島塞瓦斯托波爾

battle.name: 西摩戰爭
battle.theater: 克里米亞半島塞瓦斯托波爾
battle.brief: 一八五三年十月俄軍越過普魯特河侵入摩爾多瓦，戰火最終燒到克里米亞半島，英法聯軍自一八五四年九月圍困塞瓦斯托波爾，歷時十七個月。雷管步槍已取代火燧成為各國步兵主力，卡面這件法國雷管步槍正是聯軍攻城步兵列陣所用的制式槍械。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 西摩戰爭一役是三方角力：俄羅斯帝國對上奧斯曼帝國，英吉利王國、法蘭西第二帝國與撒丁王國聯手介入。俄軍體系最完整也最龐大，歐洲常備軍約八十萬，國事由沙皇尼古拉一世以御前會議直轄；一八五三年出動的是帕斯凱維奇元帥指揮的多瑙河軍團，入侵摩爾多瓦與瓦拉幾亞，之後遠征克里米亞的集團軍由科爾尼洛夫海軍上將與托特列本工程少將經營塞城防務。奧軍以伊斯坦堡為樞紐，總參謀長穆斯塔法・費夫茲・恰克馬克統率多瑙河方面軍，奧馬爾帕夏帶領本部兵團與埃及非正規騎兵北援。英國以拉格蘭公爵為總司令，遠征軍由本土團、印度部隊與愛爾蘭部隊拼成，配海軍陸戰隊與工兵連；法國由拿破崙三世直接統率，馬穆特元帥率法軍遠征軍登陸，另有比塞大軍官率分遣隊作戰。撒丁王國派出拉馬爾拉元帥率領約一萬五千名皮埃蒙特兵員，是全戰場唯一以本國志願兵為主的外軍。聯軍背後有奧地利帝國的外交支持，普魯士王國則以戰爭是否正當為由保持中立，令整個歐洲的補給線都只能靠海路維持。
countriesEn: The Crimean War was a three-cornered struggle: the Russian Empire on one side, the Ottoman Empire on the other, with Britain, the Second French Empire and the Kingdom of Sardinia intervening. The Russian system was the most complete and by far the largest, a peacetime European army of about 800,000 men under a chain of command running straight from Tsar Nicholas I through his council of state. The force sent into the Danubian Principalities in 1853 was the Danube army of Field Marshal Ivan Paskevich, and the invasion of Moldavia and Wallachia was followed by an expeditionary group in Crimea whose defence of Sevastopol was run by Admiral Vladimir Kornilov and the engineer-general Eduard Totleben. The Ottoman army was organised from Constantinople, with the grand vizier Mustafa Fevzi Cakmak commanding the Danube front, while Omar Pasha led his own corps and the Egyptian irregular cavalry north to meet the Anglo-French landing. Britain was commanded by Lord Raglan, and its expeditionary force was pieced together from home regiments, Indian troops and Irish units, with marines and engineer companies attached. France was under Napoleon III in person, Marshal MacMahon leading the expeditionary corps ashore and generals such as Bizet commanding detachments. The Kingdom of Sardinia sent about 15,000 Piedmontese under Alfonso La Marmora, the only foreign contingent in the war drawn mainly from volunteers of the state that sent it. Behind the allies stood the diplomatic support of the Austrian Empire, while Prussia held itself apart on the ground that the war was not a just one, which meant the whole coalition had to be supplied by sea.
people: 沙皇尼古拉一世是俄方最高決策者，自居正教守護者，一八五四年與奧地利交涉破裂後病逝，由亞歷山大二世接位。帕斯凱維奇元帥率多瑙河軍團攻入瓦拉幾亞，一八五三年底被解除指揮。科爾尼洛夫海軍上將主持塞城海上防務與登陸灘頭反擊，一八五五年三月十七日在馬拉霍夫角率反攻時陣亡；托特列本工程少將用三個月把外城改成要塞，一八五五年三月十日在同一處反攻中受重傷不治；接任的納希莫夫海軍上將寧可燒船亦不肯交城，七月因霍亂病逝。奧方代表是奧馬爾帕夏與恰克馬克。英方以拉格蘭公爵為總司令，一八五五年六月二十八日在巴拉克拉夫營地病逝，由辛普森中將接任；帕麥斯頓在倫敦主導政策，亞伯丁內閣同年十二月倒台。卡迪根伯爵與盧肯爵士在巴拉克拉夫執行輕騎旅衝鋒，命令由拉格蘭發出，結果失當。拿破崙三世一八五五年九月親赴克里米亞前線，成為第一位踏足戰場的歐洲君主。佛羅倫斯・南丁格爾一八五五年三月率三十八名護士抵達斯庫塔里；威廉姆・芬威克・威廉斯守卡爾斯、恰爾迪尼率撒丁步兵、科德靈頓中校在克里米亞改進射擊操典。
peopleEn: Tsar Nicholas I was the supreme decision-maker on the Russian side, styling himself protector of the Orthodox, and after his negotiations with Austria broke down he fell ill and died, Alexander II succeeding him. Field Marshal Paskevich led the Danube army into Wallachia and was relieved of his command at the end of 1853. Admiral Vladimir Kornilov directed the naval defence of Sevastopol and the counter-stroke against the landing beaches, and was killed on 17 March 1855 while leading the Russian counter-assault on the Malakoff. The engineer-general Eduard Totleben turned the suburbs into a fortress in three months, and on 10 March 1855 was mortally wounded in the counter-attack on the same height. His successor, Admiral Nakhimov, preferred to burn his ships rather than surrender the city, and died of cholera in July. The Ottoman commanders were Omar Pasha and Cakmak. On the British side Lord Raglan was commander-in-chief until his death from illness at Balaklava on 28 June 1855, when Sir James Simpson took over; in London Palmerston drove policy and the Aberdeen ministry fell in December of the same year. Lord Cardigan and Lord Lucan carried out the charge of the Light Brigade at Balaklava on orders issued by Raglan, and the result was a disaster. Napoleon III visited the Crimean front in September 1855, the first reigning monarch to set foot on a battlefield. Florence Nightingale reached Scutari in March 1855 with thirty-eight nurses; William Fenwick Williams held Kars, Cialdini commanded the Sardinian infantry, and Lieutenant-Colonel Codrington worked out new firing drills in the Crimea.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是法國雷管步槍，即法軍在一八四○年代將前裝火繩槍改用底火擊發之後的制式步槍：一八四六年式步兵槍槍身約一米三六，另有加刺刀的一米四七版本，配一八四七年式雷管機與底火，發給全線列步兵及一線支援的志願兵。在克里米亞，聯軍步兵的火力核心是英軍一八五三年式恩菲爾德來膛槍，每槍可預裝十四發、射程約四百碼，在塞城周邊的起伏地上壓過俄軍前裝線列步槍；俄軍直到一八五五年才逐步以米尼式步槍取代舊槍，射程由二百步拉到八百步以上，令塹壕內的對射性質改變。攻城方面，聯軍用英國海軍三十二磅砲與砲艦重砲組成野戰砲兵與攻城重砲群，再以沙袋、柴束與木製胸牆修築塹溝；英軍在塞城塹內鋪設約二百二十碼長、六吋軌距的窄軌鐵路專運補給。海路方面聯軍以巡防艦與汽船巡邏黑海，攔截俄軍增援船隊；俄方靠黑海艦隊與沿岸登陸點維持補給，切斷海路交通是圍城戰的關鍵。
kitsEn: The piece on the card is the French percussion rifle, the standard infantry arm the French army obtained in the 1840s when old muzzle-loading matchlock muskets were converted to percussion ignition: the Model 1846 infantry musket has a barrel of about 1.36 metres, a bayonet variant running to about 1.47 metres, and both take the Model 1847 percussion lock and cap, issued to the whole of the line infantry and to the volunteers attached to it. In the Crimea the core of allied infantry firepower was the British Model 1853 Enfield rifled musket, which held fourteen rounds in the magazine and had a range of some four hundred yards, and on the broken ground around Sevastopol it out-shot the old smoothbore line muskets of the Russians. The Russians only began replacing the old musket with the Minie rifle in 1855, which lifted effective range from about two hundred paces to more than eight hundred and changed the character of the shooting inside the trenches. For the siege the allies formed field batteries and heavy siege guns out of naval thirty-two pounders and shipborne ordnance, faced the approaches with sandbags, fascines and timber mantlets, and laid a narrow-gauge railway about two hundred and twenty yards long on a six-inch gauge inside the trenches at Sevastopol to shift supplies. At sea the allied frigates and steamers patrolled the Black Sea and hunted down Russian supply ships, while Russia kept the garrison fed through its own Black Sea fleet and coastal landing points, and severing that sea traffic was the decisive logistical question of the siege.
tactics: 圍城戰分封鎖、掘壕、砲擊與突擊四個階段。聯軍先以分艦隊封住黑海港口，再築三道平行壕溝，每道相隔數百碼，由工兵逐段向前推進並在前線砌起胸牆，令俄軍不能直接望到壕內炮手。俄方用「小直布羅陀」與馬拉霍夫角的反砲台居高臨下封鎖聯軍塹溝，一八五五年五月三日更從地底引爆炸藥炸塌英軍大塹溝一段，聯軍其後用反坑道逐段反制。步兵戰術也在此改寫：來膛步槍與滑膛炮令密集縱隊極易被殲，阿爾馬之役俄軍以縱隊攻山被英軍側射擊退，一八五四年十一月五日的因奇曼之役在暴雨夜霧中英軍死守山脊，之後科德靈頓中校在克里米亞推行連續射擊的朗格操典，線列步兵改以散兵線配合射擊。騎兵在巴拉克拉夫與俄軍砲兵對撼，輕騎旅五個中隊正面強襲俄軍砲位，傷亡慘重。卡爾斯與塞城之間的地峽戰則以攻守拉鋸見長，遠程槍砲在狹窄地帶反覆爭奪高地。
tacticsEn: The siege moved through four stages: blockade, trenching, bombardment and assault. The allies first sealed the Black Sea ports with detached squadrons, then dug three parallel trenches a few hundred yards apart, pushing them forward section by section with the engineers and raising parapets at the front so that the Russians could not look directly down on the gunners in the trench. The Russians answered with counter-batteries on the Little Gibraltar and the Malakoff that dominated the allied approaches, and on 3 May 1855 they fired a mine that blew in a section of the British great trench, the allies answering by counter-mining their way forward. Infantry tactics were rewritten here as well: with rifled muskets and smoothbore guns a dense column was easy to annihilate, the Russian columns attacking the heights at Alma were swept by British flank fire, and at Inkerman on 5 November 1854 the British held a ridge through a night of wind and rain, after which Lieutenant-Colonel Codrington introduced the Lange drill of continuous fire, line infantry working in looser order supported by skirmishers. The cavalry grappled with Russian artillery at Balaklava, where five squadrons of the Light Brigade charged the Russian battery head on and were badly cut up. The fighting in the ravines between Kars and Sevastopol took the form of repeated struggles for the heights, long rifles and guns pounding the narrow ground.
data: 戰事由一八五三年十月延至一八五六年三月，歷時約兩年五個月；其中塞瓦斯托波爾圍城由一八五四年九月到一八五五年三月，長達十七個月。一八五四年九月首批登陸的英軍遠征軍約二萬九千人、配七十門砲，到一八五五年塞城周邊聯軍總兵力約五萬至六萬人，英軍、法軍、撒丁軍各佔一萬至三萬不等；俄軍守城部隊初期約四萬人，隨著國內援軍不斷入城增至五萬以上。傷亡方面，英軍在戰區死亡約二萬一千人，其中陣亡約二千六百人，其餘主要死於霍亂與斑疹傷寒；法軍死亡約八千至九千人；俄方陣亡重傷人數各家估計差距極大，多數研究認為在三萬人上下。全役步槍擊發以數百萬發計，攻城砲擊發射砲彈以萬計。一八五五年二月二十八日巴拉克拉夫暴風摧毀聯軍營帳、碼頭與醫藥儲備，數百匹馬匹死亡，英軍損失最重的是儲存與運輸能力。財政上英國在一八五五年加徵半便士茶稅，財政部估計首年可多收八百萬鎊，實際收款遠超預算；同年年底的塞城戰役亦催生維多利亞十字勳章的設立。
dataEn: The war ran from October 1853 to March 1856, about two years and five months, and the siege of Sevastopol itself lasted seventeen months, from September 1854 to March 1855. The first British contingent to land in September 1854 numbered about 29,000 men with seventy guns, and by 1855 the allied force surrounding Sevastopol stood at roughly 50,000 to 60,000 men, with British, French and Sardinian contingents of between 10,000 and 30,000 each; the Russian garrison began at about 40,000 and rose above 50,000 as reinforcements were fed in from the interior. On losses, some 21,000 British soldiers died in the theatre, of whom about 2,600 were killed in action and the rest died mainly of cholera and typhus; French dead numbered some eight to nine thousand; for Russia the estimates of killed and wounded vary widely, and most studies put the figure at around thirty thousand. The war consumed millions of musket rounds and tens of thousands of siege-gun shots. The gale of 28 February 1855 tore down allied tents, the landing stage and the medical stores, killing several hundred horses, and the worst loss for the British lay in stores and transport. On the financial side Britain levied a halfpenny duty on tea in 1855, the Chancellor of the Exchequer estimating eight million pounds for the first year, and the actual receipts ran well beyond that; the fighting at Sevastopol late in 1855 also produced the institution of the Victoria Cross.
cause: 衝突根源是東方問題。俄國自十九世紀中葉起以正教民族保護者自居，要求奧斯曼帝國廢除對希臘正教社群的特殊待遇，並將境內正教徒置於俄國領事裁判之下；一八五二年俄軍先行佔領多瑙河兩岸的摩爾多瓦與瓦拉幾亞，翌年要求奧斯曼廢除舊約並將黑海與海峽條款改為由俄國單方面把關。四月被拒後，俄國大使門希科夫在五月離開君士坦丁堡視為決裂訊號，同年十月俄軍越過普魯特河、扶植親俄的瓦拉幾亞政府，奧軍跟隨渡河反擊，十一月奧特尼察之役雙方首次大規模交鋒，衝突由邊境摩擦升級為全面戰爭。英國與法國介入不是為了援助正教徒，而是不想俄國取得黑海門戶與君士坦丁堡的戰略優勢，危及地中海航道、糧食貿易與歐洲均勢；兩國同年三月簽互助條約、四月對俄宣戰，聯同西班牙、葡萄牙、荷蘭與瑞典等國參與行動。撒丁王國加入則是卡伏爾的外交賭注，他想在巴黎和會上取得一席，為意大利統一鋪路。
causeEn: The root of the conflict was the Eastern Question. From the middle of the nineteenth century Russia presented itself as protector of the Orthodox nation, demanding that the Ottoman Empire abolish the special treatment of the Greek Orthodox communities and place Orthodox subjects in the empire under Russian consular jurisdiction. In 1852 Russian troops occupied Moldavia and Wallachia on the Danube in advance, and the following year Russia demanded the abrogation of the old treaties and a rewriting of the Black Sea and straits clauses so that the right of decision would rest with it alone. Rejected in April, the departure of the Russian ambassador Menshikov from Constantinople in May was taken as a signal of rupture, and in October of that year Russian troops crossed the Prut and set up a client government in Wallachia; the Ottomans followed across the Danube in reply, and the battle of Oltenita in November brought the first large collisions, turning friction on the frontier into a general war. Britain and France intervened not out of any wish to aid Orthodox Christians, but because they would not let Russia take the approaches to the Black Sea and Constantinople and so imperil the Mediterranean sea lanes, the grain trade and the balance of power in Europe. The two powers signed a mutual defence treaty in March and declared war on Russia in April, joined by Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands and Sweden, among others. Sardinia entered for reasons of Cavour's own diplomacy, for he wanted a seat at the Congress of Paris and a platform for Italian unification.
impact: 西摩戰爭是十九世紀歐洲權力結構的轉折點。俄國第一次在歐洲大陸正面敗北，國際孤立加深，神聖同盟的框架崩解，巴黎和會標誌着大國協商式外交正式成形；奧地利因未取得預期戰果而聲望受損，普魯士以戰爭是否正當為由保持中立，反而坐實了它的孤立處境，為其後俾斯麥的鐵血政策埋下伏線。義大利方面，皮埃蒙特代表卡伏爾出席和會取得外交能見度，統一運動得到外部支持。奧斯曼帝國雖然慘勝，卻背上巨額外債，英資於一八五六年入股成立帝國奧斯曼銀行，蘇丹其後頒布改革詔書，軍隊西化改革自此加速。軍事技術上，克里米亞是第一場以來膛步槍主導、舊式滑膛炮退居二線的戰爭，散兵線與連續射擊的重要性被寫入各國操典，直接影響其後美國內戰與普丹戰爭的編制。醫療衛生的改革更加深遠，南丁格爾與衛生委員會的統計報告催生一八五八年《醫療法》與一八五九年衛生總局，軍隊醫學教育亦由內特利基地制度化。
impactEn: The Crimean War was a turning point in the power structure of nineteenth century Europe. Russia suffered its first open defeat on the European continent, its isolation deepened and the framework of the Holy Alliance fell apart, while the Congress of Paris marked the formal beginning of great power diplomacy conducted by consultation. Austria, denied the results it had expected, lost standing; Prussia stayed out on the ground that the war was not just, and in doing so confirmed its own isolation, laying the ground for the iron and blood policy Bismarck would later pursue. For Italy, Cavour's Piedmontese delegation at the congress brought diplomatic visibility and outside support to the unification movement. The Ottoman Empire won, but at the price of heavy foreign debt; British capital took a share in the Imperial Ottoman Bank in 1856, the sultan issued a reform edict, and the westernising reform of the army moved forward from that point. On the technical side Crimea was the first war fought with the rifled musket in the leading role and the old smoothbore gun demoted to a secondary arm; the value of loose order and continuous fire was written into the drill of every army and shaped the organisation of the American Civil War and of the Russo-Turkish War of 1877-78 that followed. The medical and sanitary reforms went deeper still: the statistics of Nightingale and the sanitary commission led to the Medical Act of 1858 and the General Board of Health of 1859, and army medical education was regularised around the Netley establishment.
result: 塞瓦斯托波爾在一八五五年三月八日因馬拉霍夫角淪陷而實質崩解，同年六月十八日英軍對大雷丹堡最後一次突擊失敗，七月俄軍完成全城撤退，聯軍佔領的只是一片廢墟，九月聯軍主力離開。真正結束戰爭的是一八五六年三月三十日的《巴黎條約》：俄國放棄對多瑙河兩公國的保護權，歸還比薩拉比亞，承認奧斯曼帝國境內正教徒的宗教自由由蘇丹處置，並同意黑海對各國海軍開放、自己不得在黑海維持海軍編制或沿岸增築要塞；黑海沿岸防務亦由列強共同保證。同一場和會簽訂《君士坦丁堡公約》以保證奧斯曼帝國領土完整，並重申一八五六年《巴黎宣言》的海戰規則。戰果對聯軍而言是慘勝：塞城得而復失，俄國海軍被鎖在黑海，尼古拉一世去世，英國學到最重要一課是遠征戰爭背後的財政與疾病代價。一八七○年俄國單方面廢除黑海條款，最終要靠一八七一年倫敦會議重新收拾。整體而言聯軍改變不了歐洲均勢的根本格局，但也將奧斯曼帝國的生存確立為歐洲列強公開承諾的國際責任。
resultEn: Sevastopol effectively collapsed when the Malakoff fell on 8 March 1855; the last British assault on the Great Redan failed on 18 June, the Russians completed the evacuation of the city in July, and the allies occupied a ruin, withdrawing their main body in September. What actually ended the war was the Treaty of Paris of 30 March 1856: Russia renounced its protectorate over the Danubian Principalities, restored Bessarabia, accepted that the religious freedom of Orthodox subjects in the Ottoman Empire would be administered by the sultan, and agreed that the Black Sea would be open to the fleets of all nations and that she would keep neither warships nor new fortifications on its coast; the defence of the shores was guaranteed jointly by the powers. The same congress concluded the Convention of Constantinople guaranteeing the integrity of the Ottoman Empire and reaffirmed the rules of naval war set out in the Declaration of Paris of 1856. For the allies the result was a costly victory: Sevastopol was taken and lost again, the Russian fleet was locked in the Black Sea, Nicholas I was dead, and the lesson Britain carried away was the financial and medical cost of fighting a distant war. In 1870 Russia unilaterally repudiated the Black Sea clauses, and it took the London Conference of 1871 to tidy the matter up. On the whole the allies did not alter the fundamental balance of Europe, but they did fix the survival of the Ottoman Empire as an international commitment openly entered into by the European powers.
